entities.name: Jędrzej Moraczewski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jędrzej Edward Moraczewski was a Polish socialist politician who served as Prime Minister of Poland from 1918 to 1919. was one of the leaders of the Polish Socialist Party. He had previously served as Minister of Communications. Subsequently, from 1925 to 1929, he served as Minister of Public Labour.
